doctrine: Human-pinned official station IDs. An override wins over name matching. Pin only a station you would defend by the water's published name — never a nearby substitute. Example: to pin Lake Washington to a specific USGS site, add { destinationId: "HHI-DEST-001", agency: "USGS", siteId: "12150400" }.
